desc: These Regional Mexican CORRIDOS TUMBADOS present young artists singing about overcoming life's struggles, drugs, inequality, resolve, perseverance and hope. Composer Guillermo Pascual blends tight, quartet performances with hip-hop style beats.

tracks.desc: Literally translated to "I was always very bold", this Regional Mexican, up-tempo 3/4 time, CORRIDO TUMBADO track recounts the daring exploits of someone who is never afraid, never contemplates the option to lose, and is always moving forward. Someone who takes the bull by it's horns and doesn't give up. Includes a playful accordion, bajoloche (electro-acoustic bass), requinto (12 string) and armonía (both steel string acoustic guitars) plus a trap beat section.

A Regional Mexican, mid-tempo 3/4 time CORRIDO TUMBADO song about "running without stopping", remembering the times when we felt our freedom, felt the need for speed, and nothing could put an end to us. Features a lively accordion, bajoloche (electro-acoustic bass), requinto (12 string) and armonía (both steel string acoustic guitars) plus a trap beat section. A modulation after the second chorus elevates the track before the end.

Some folks are born blessed, others are not so fortunate... this is the message of this Regional Mexican, mid-tempo 3/4 time CORRIDO TUMBADO song about overcoming strife and having to persevere to survive. Features a lively accordion, bajoloche (electro-acoustic bass), requinto (12 string) and armonía (both steel string acoustic guitars) plus a trap beat section. The half-time feel used for the final chorus gives the ending a cool retro vibe.

"I will not change". This Regional Mexican, 3/4 time CORRIDO TUMBADO song with varying tempos speaks about controlling the border, territorial conflict and never changing one's resolve to defend what is rightfully theirs. "I'm not a bad person, but I'll do what I have to do." Features a bajoloche (electro-acoustic bass), accordion, requinto (12 string) and armonía (both steel string acoustic guitars) plus a trap beat section. The song's dynamic shifts add to the heartfelt, moody vibe.

A Regional Mexican, mid-tempo 3/4 time CORRIDO TUMBADO song about the craving to consume certain recreational substances after working long twelve hour days. Also the desire to earn... and then live it up at the night club and dance until dawn. Features a mercurial trombone, bajoloche (electro-acoustic bass), requinto (12 string) and armonía (both steel string acoustic guitars) plus a trap beat section.
